up2:0.1: The Verses on the Great Blessings of Success
up2:1.1: The lord of great compassion, for the benefit of all living creatures,
up2:1.2: having fulfilled all the perfections has attained supreme and Complete Awakening.
up2:1.3: By this declaration of the truth may you have the blessing of success!
up2:2.1: Succeeding at the root of the Bodhi tree he furthered the Sakyans’ joy -
up2:2.2: so may you be successful, may you succeed with the blessing of success!
up2:3.1: Having honoured the Buddha treasure, the best and supreme medicine,
up2:3.2: of benefit to gods and men, by the blessed power of the Buddha
up2:3.3: may all adversities perish, and all suffering come to an end for you!
up2:4.1: Having honoured the Dhamma treasure, the best and supreme medicine,
up2:4.2: which brings fevers to an end, by the blessed power of the Dhamma
up2:4.3: may all adversities perish, and all fear come to an end for you!
up2:5.1: Having honoured the Saṅgha treasure, the best and supreme medicine,
up2:5.2: worthy of gifts and hospitality, by the blessed power of the Saṅgha
up2:5.3: may all adversities perish, and all disease come to an end for you!
up2:6.1: Whatever the many and various treasures there are in the world
up2:6.2: no treasure is equal to the Buddha: through this (truth) may you be safe!
up2:7.1: Whatever the many and various treasures there are in the world
up2:7.2: no treasure is equal to the Dhamma: through this (truth) may you be safe!
up2:8.1: Whatever the many and various treasures there are in the world
up2:8.2: no treasure is equal to the Saṅgha: through this (truth) may you be safe!
up2:9.1: For me there is no other refuge, for me the Buddha is the best refuge!
up2:9.2: By this declaration of the truth may you have the blessing of success!
up2:10.1: For me there is no other refuge, for me the Dhamma is the best refuge!
up2:10.2: By this declaration of the truth may you have the blessing of success!
up2:11.1: For me there is no other refuge, for me the Saṅgha is the best refuge!
up2:11.2: By this declaration of the truth may you have the blessing of success!
up2:12.1: May you avoid all calamities and may all disease be destroyed,
up2:12.2: may there be no obstacles for you, may you be happy and live long!
